description: Land Title Settlement Department - Homagama, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520001 (23/55023)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically calling for claims to intestate property (property of deceased persons without a will) under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land descriptions including cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and certificate of title numbers. The notice is issued by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement regarding the registration of land titles, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
